data.name: Sarukh
data.gender_notes: Sarukh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules the good fortune, prosperity, and auspiciousness. The name Sarukh carries the meaning “Ruler of the Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Sarukh usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes one's connection to the divine and the ability to bring good fortune and prosperity into their life.
data.etymology: Sarukh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sarukh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sarukh in Hindu culture is associated with power, prosperity, and good fortune. The prefix "Saru-" means "lord" or "ruler," and the suffix "-kh" denotes "auspiciousness" or "good fortune." Thus, Sarukh is seen as a name that signifies the possessor or ruler of all things good and prosperous.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name Sarukh holds greater significance, representing one's connection to the divine and the positive energies of the universe. The prefix "Saru-" signifies the divine and the ruler of all things, while the suffix "-kh" represents the auspiciousness and positive energy that flows from the divine to the individual.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sarukh: The radiant one, illuminating the path of truth with inner wisdom and strength. Saraswati's grace bestows eloquence and knowledge upon this being.
